C1003.title: July 16 Targeted Penalty Announcement for 'Actor' Behavior
C1003.summary: On July 16, 2025, Honor of Kings officials issued a targeted penalty announcement against 'actor' behavior. The in-game reporting system penalized offending players with measures such as leaderboard bans, leaderboard resets, credit score deductions, and matchmaking bans based on severity, and released the list of penalized players to reinforce actions against behavior that pollutes the game enviro
